name: print-social-black-carousel-set-with-blue-highlights-and-white-asterisk-stickers
title: Six black educational slides with blue highlight bars, big asterisks and a drag-to-slide pill
whatItIs: A pin preview of six portrait slides on black with a small logo strip, white bold questions ('Be careful, why?', 'First, What is tone of voice?') with blue highlighted phrases, white asterisk stickers, 3D objects like gears and a bag and a 'Drag to slide' pill at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Bold and instructional; blue highlights and asterisks give structure on black.
techniques: Highlight key phrases with blue bars.
End each slide with a swipe pill.

vocabulary.definition: A slide opening with a question.
